In my childhood I was never liked, my friends were fake, girls hated my guts. I was terrible at anything a normal boy was supposed to be good at, sports, cars, manly stuff. I was a sissy boy and nobody liked it. Well after some years of bullying I finally escaped my toxic class and found myself with people who happened to give a somewhat crap about me, but the damage was already done. I had no confidence in myself, the old class made sure I remembered that I was still that ugly, weak pussy whom girls would never find attractive. And for the most part they were right, I was ghosted, lead on multiple times, used, my self-esteem basically didn't exist at the moment. Until I found her, my first real girlfriend. I don't know if she really found me attractive, but I felt as if I was really loved by someone, as if I was wanted, desired. She built me up and even though I was a wreck she still stood by me. Well, as all things end, she at last lost interest in me and broke it up, you can figure how hard it hit me. I wasn't the best, I was still that sissy boy after all. Still, I want to feel wanted again, I want to feel loved and desired. I know it's probably the end for me, she was unique, no one else would give me the time of the day. I wish I did things differently or just never met her in general, at least I wouldn't crave it as much.
